from datetime import datetime
result = []
for row in raw_times:
    ts = datetime.strptime(row["raw"], "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
    result.append({"raw": row["raw"], "date": ts.date().isoformat(), "hour": ts.hour, "weekday": ts.isoweekday()})
display(result)
